description: Azure vs AWS for one VM requirement: the cheapest Azure VM size and the cheapest AWS EC2 instance type with at least the given vCPUs and memory in a pair of nearby regions, monthly USD list prices side by side (pay as you go / On-Demand and 3-year reserved), which cloud is cheaper and by how much. Intel/AMD only unless include_arm is true.

include_arm.description: Also consider Arm sizes (AWS Graviton, Azure Cobalt/Ampere). Default false.

os.description: Operating system for pay-as-you-go prices. Default linux.

region.description: AWS region code, its paired Azure region or the city. Default us-east-1 (Azure eastus). Pairs: us-east-1 = eastus (US East (N. Virginia)); us-east-2 = centralus (US Central (Ohio / Iowa)); us-west-1 = westus3 (US West (N. California / Arizona)); us-west-2 = westus2 (US West (Oregon / Washington)); ca-central-1 = canadacentral (Canada); sa-east-1 = brazilsouth (Brazil (São Paulo)); eu-west-1 = northeurope (Ireland); eu-west-2 = uksouth (London); eu-west-3 = francecentral (Paris); eu-central-1 = germanywestcentral (Frankfurt); eu-central-2 = switzerlandnorth (Zurich); eu-north-1 = swedencentral (Sweden); eu-south-1 = italynorth (Milan); ap-south-1 = centralindia (India); ap-southeast-1 = southeastasia (Singapore); ap-southeast-2 = australiaeast (Sydney); ap-northeast-1 = japaneast (Tokyo); ap-northeast-2 = koreacentral (Seoul); ap-east-1 = eastasia (Hong Kong); me-central-1 = uaenorth (UAE).
